about: Phase 9B review-package inputs written by the assistant (the Phase 8 case author). For every Phase 8 case: the table column the claim is about (as named in c4 tables.jsonl), an optional extra note on the current label, and optional preparer flags. Flags are the preparer's own doubts, offered to the reviewer; they do NOT change any label. Labels stay exactly as in experiments/phase8/table_semantics_{cases,heldout}.json.

table_notes.HNET:T6: Source data/raw/HNET/src/tab/related.tex. HNET defines \cmark = \ding{51} (check) and \xmark = \ding{55} (cross) in main.tex lines 94-95; both print visibly. No legend defines what a check or cross means. Many marks are \multirow cells shared by several rows. The caption says H-Net 'is the first architecture that enables dynamic, multi-stage hierarchies' and points to the background section for discussion.
table_notes.MOSHI:T3: Source sections/evaluation.tex (tab:mimi_ablations). MOSHI defines \xmark as EMPTY (main.tex line 44: \newcommand{\xmark}{}), so every \xmark prints as a blank cell in the PDF; \checkmark prints a check. c4 shows \xmark cells as '(blank)'. No legend. Prose in 5.2 ('Results - Acoustic tokens': 'improvement in MUSHRA when adding a Transformer in the decoder') reads the columns as components that are present or absent.
table_notes.MOSHI:T4: Source sections/evaluation.tex (tab:mimi_baselines). The causal column uses \xmark (defined EMPTY, prints blank) for RVQGAN, SemantiCodec and SpeechTokenizer, and \checkmark for the Mimi rows. c4 shows '(blank)'. Separate prose in 5.2 ('Results - Acoustic tokens') says: 'both RVQGAN and SemantiCodec are non-causal, while Mimi is fully causal'. SpeechTokenizer's causality is not stated in prose.
table_notes.MOSHI:T6: Source sections/evaluation.tex (tab:ablation-delays). Row 1 Inner Monologue is \xmark (prints blank, c4 '(blank)'); rows 2-5 Inner Monologue and row 4 Depthwise are genuinely empty LaTeX cells (c4 shows them as absent/''). Both print blank. No legend. Weight cells in c4 carry the \phantom defect (001.0); the PDF prints 1.0.
table_notes.MOSHI:T13: Source sections/safety.tex (tab:regurgitation). Empty cells are genuinely empty LaTeX (not a macro). No legend. The caption says: 'With dataset deduplication, we do not observe any exact re-generation ... even if we prompt the model with the first 3s'. Rows 7 and 8 of the single-stream block are identical.
table_notes.MOSHI:T16: Source sections/safety.tex (tab:idempotence). The RVQGAN attack column holds \checkmark or a genuinely empty cell. The caption calls the attacks 'optional audio post-processing attacks' including 're-encoding with RVQGAN'.

A reader may take the cross as 'no'. No legend states it. The current label applies the Phase 8 rule that a mark is never converted into a property.

ablation_reading: in this ablation table the authors write \checkmark for an included component and \xmark (printed blank) otherwise, and 5.2 prose reads the columns as components added or removed. A reviewer may judge 'does not use a split quantizer' supported by the paper even though no legend states it.

s25.note: The 6.5% row has MUSHRA 57.8; the highest MUSHRA in the table is 68.3 (row 5). The claim is contradicted, not only unsupported.

A reviewer may judge the claim supported by the paper; the current label applies the rule that a blank is never read as 'no'.
